pre_condition: proj_dir is a string representing an existing filesystem directory.
post_condition: Returns a dictionary mapping absolute filesystem paths (str) to lists of (function_name: str, body_text: str) tuples for all C++ source files identified in proj_dir and its subdirectories. If the CodeGraph extraction backend is unavailable or fails to initialize for the project, returns an empty dictionary. Each key in the returned dictionary is an absolute path to a C++ source file that contains at least one function definition; each associated value is a non-empty list of (func_name, body) tuples extracted from that file.
